basic_info.description: Incredible Views in Sunnyside! This rare opportunity is perfect for buyers looking for a newer construction single-family home alternative. Featuring a reverse floorplan with amazing views, this home includes 3 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, and 1 half bathroom. The entry hallway leads to the first of 3 master suites perfect for guests or an au pair. On the second level, a private deck off of the open living and dining area provides incredible entertaining space with views of the Southern hills. Downstairs are two additional en-suite bedrooms with access to the deeded backyard. This home is complete with a laundry closet with a full-size washer and dryer, 1-car garage parking, a Tesla charger, and flex space perfect for a home office, gym, wine cellar, or media room. The location near Glen Park BART station with easy access to freeways makes this home a commuter's dream. Best of all, this property is eligible for fast-track condo conversion!
